enrich.rationale: Residual-UCB active learning will concentrate new simulations where the current winner demonstrably underperforms, maximizing RMSE reduction per added sample to close the small remaining gap to the target.

diagnosis: Residuals remain structured and strongly correlated with key inputs (r0, a, kappa, delta, Ip) while the learning curve is still improving and split variance is low, indicating a sample-coverage bottleneck in specific regions.
